contentType.description: if specified will convert to {@link MediaType} specifically VisualMediaType

width.description: if specified will scale to width

height.description: if specified will scale to height

channelCount.description: Number of channels for image eg R G B A

pixelCount.description: Number of pixels in the image

startOffsetSec.description: start offset inclusive for video to operate on, if not specified will operate from start of the video

endOffsetSec.description: end offset exclusive for video to operate on, if not specified will operate till the end of the video

title: Options to operate on a video
name: VideoOperSpec
